See on nii tüütu!

{01 08 00}accident{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}See tähendab, kuni...{01 01 00}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}From what I hear,{01 00 00 0f 00} when
he was young he was hit in 
the head by a soccer ball.
He wasn't hurt, {01 00 00 05 00}but from
then on he started 
mumbling random philosophy.
{07 14 00}It was like all of a
sudden, a philosopher was
born, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nagu ma kuulsin,{01 00 00 0f 00} sai ta
noorena jalgpalliga 
vastu pead.
Ta ei saanud viga, {01 00 00 05 00}aga
sellest ajast hakkas ta 
pomisema filosoofiat.
{07 14 00}Justkui oleks äkitselt
sündinud filosoof,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}He sits on his lazy rump, 
stares at the sea,{01 00 00 05 00} and 
theories just come to him.
{07 15 00}But for some lame reason,{01 00 00 05 00}
he'll only share them once,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}After that,{01 00 00 05 00} he jumps into 
the sea and swims off.

Some of his ideas are cool,
I guess.{01 00 00 05 00} But why does he 
have to be such a freak?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ta istub laisalt paigal, 
vahib merd,{01 00 00 05 00} ja teooriad 
lihtsalt tulevad talle.
{07 15 00}Aga mingil tobedal põhjusel{01 00 00 05 00}
jagab ta neid ainult korra,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Siis{01 00 00 05 00} hüppab ta merre 
ja ujub minema.

Mõned ta ideed on lahedad,
vist.{01 00 00 05 00} Aga miks peab ta 
selline veidrik olema?
